fields.name: gyro
fields.source: sensordata[gyro sensor]; IMU-site local angular velocity

observation.history_note: No frame stack; upstream history_len configuration is unused.
state_update: choose action from current observation; hold motor targets and force for n_substeps
poststep: observation_last_action=last_action; walking G1 only: observation_phase=phase; construct observation
then last_action=action; walking G1 only: phase=fmod(phase+phase_dt+pi,2*pi)-pi
observe() reads the observation-time history without advancing it
observation.action_history: With a[t] applied at step t, o[t+1] contains a[t-1], not a[t]; reset history is zero.
observation.sensor_timing: Keep mj_step sensor stage; no extra mj_forward after the final substep.

control.target_update: Compute once per control step, hold through all internal substeps.
control.limits: No Python action/target clipping; MuJoCo actuator ctrl/force limits still apply.

normalizer.formula: (observation-mean)/std; no added epsilon; clip only when non-null

value.weights: Stored only in brax_params_file; unused by inference.

policy.scale_formula: softplus(logits[..., action_size:])+0.001; unused by deterministic inference
